Remember to USE your Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry to weaken the triad. They cannot be killed otherwise - but use them wisely...

quests.name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
objectiveText: Listen to Royal Historian Archesonus recant the history of Thaurissan.

objectiveText: Find Hilary's Necklace, and return it to Hilary in Lakeshire.

objectiveText: Speak with Franclorn Forgewright if you are interested in obtaining a key to the city major.

quests.name: Dark Iron Legacy
objectiveText: Slay Fineous Darkvire and recover the great hammer, Ironfel. Take Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of Franclorn Forgewright.

quests.name: Dreadmaul Rock
objectiveText: Venture forth to the Burning Steppes and find out what became of Sha'ni Proudtusk.

quests.name: Krom'Grul
objectiveText: Recover Sha'ni's Nose-Ring from Krom'Grul and return it to Thal'trak in Kargath. Search the various caves and mines in Dreadmaul Rock.

quests.name: Extinguish the Firegut
objectiveText: Slay 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres, and 7 Firegut Ogre Brutes, and return to Oralius when you are finished.

quests.name: Gor'tesh the Brute Lord
objectiveText: Find Gor'tesh, somewhere to the west of Dreadmaul Rock. Kill Gor'tesh and then take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head back to Oralius in Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party
objectiveText: Take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head and place it at the top of Dreadmaul Rock. Look for a soft dirt mound to plant the pike.

quests.name: An Orphan Looking For a Home
objectiveText: Speak to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: A Short Incubation
objectiveText: Bring 2 Elixir of Fortitudes to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: The Newest Member of the Family
objectiveText: Take your Fragile Sprite Darter Egg to the Hinterlands and speak to Agnar Beastamer, but hurry, you only have 1 hour to find him before the hatchling within the egg dies.

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
objectiveText: Look around in the pond for a clue about who this wrecked raft may belong to.

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
objectiveText: Examine the items inside the pack and bring them to their owner.

quests.name: CLUCK!
objectiveText: Find some Special Chicken Feed and return to your befriended chicken. When you find it, /cheer at it before trying to give it the Special Chicken Feed.

quests.name: Expedition Salvation
objectiveText: Bring a Crate of Foodstuffs and Research Equipment to Williden Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Roll the Bones
objectiveText: Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Alien Ecology
objectiveText: Use the Scraping Vial to collect a Hive Wall Sample from one of the Gorishi hive hatcheries in Un'Goro Crater. Look for the chambers with the hanging larval spawns.
Bring the Hive Wall Sample to Hol'anyee Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Williden's Journal
objectiveText: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Rattling the Rattlecages
objectiveText: Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.

quests.name: Scavenging Deathknell
objectiveText: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.

quests.name: Milly Osworth
objectiveText: Speak with Milly Osworth.

quests.name: Milly's Harvest
objectiveText: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Grape Manifest
objectiveText: Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Disharmony of Flame
objectiveText: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.

quests.name: Disharmony of Fire
objectiveText: Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
objectiveText: Take Linken's Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: The Videre Elixir
objectiveText: Seek out Gregan Brewspewer in northern Feralas. From him, learn how you may acquire the Videre Elixir, then return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Meet at the Grave
objectiveText: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir. Follow the rest of Donova's instructions to find Gaeriyan.

quests.name: A Grave Situation
objectiveText: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.

quests.name: Linken's Sword
objectiveText: Deliver Linken's Superior Sword to Linken in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
objectiveText: Bring the Broken Samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket.

quests.name: Nugget Slugs
objectiveText: Bring 15 Nugget Slugs to Wenikee Boltbucket in the Barrens.

quests.name: Rilli Greasygob
objectiveText: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Samophlange Manual
objectiveText: Bring the Samophlange Manual to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: A Gnome's Assistance
objectiveText: Find J.D. Collie in the cave at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Linken's Memory
objectiveText: Find Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.

quests.name: Linken's Adventure
objectiveText: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: It's Dangerous to Go Alone
objectiveText: Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge.
Find Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the Golden Flame from the cave.

quests.name: Commander Gor'shak
objectiveText: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths.
You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.

quests.name: What Is Going On?
objectiveText: Defend Gor'shak.

quests.name: What Is Going On?
objectiveText: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping. Take that information to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
You recall Gor'shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.

quests.name: The Eastern Kingdom
objectiveText: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

quests.name: The Royal Rescue
objectiveText: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.

quests.name: The Princess Saved?
objectiveText: Return to Thrall!

quests.name: Aquementas
objectiveText: Take the Book of Aquor, the Silvery Claws, and the Irontree Heart to Tanaris.
Use the Book of Aquor to summon Aquementas.
After you have the completed totem, take it to J.D. Collie in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Counterattack!
objectiveText: Bring a Piece of Krom'zar's Banner to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
objectiveText: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
objectiveText: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.
You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.
You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence.
Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
objectiveText: Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania.
You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
objectiveText: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus.
You recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
objectiveText: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

quests.name: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
objectiveText: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.

quests.name: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
objectiveText: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.

quests.name: Silver Heart
objectiveText: Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.

quests.name: Cleansing Felwood
objectiveText: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Arathandris Silversky in Felwood.

quests.name: Cleansing Felwood
objectiveText: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in Felwood.

quests.name: The Strength of Corruption
objectiveText: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.

quests.name: Precarious Predicament
objectiveText: Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge.
You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.
You will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.

quests.name: Grark Lorkrub
objectiveText: Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.

When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.

quests.name: The Heart of the Mountain
objectiveText: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: The Missing Courier
objectiveText: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Missing Courier
objectiveText: Locate the courier's boat somewhere along the coast of Feralas.

quests.name: Hurley Blackbreath
objectiveText: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.

quests.name: Boat Wreckage
objectiveText: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold and show Ginro Hearthkindle the Discarded Knife you have found.

quests.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
objectiveText: Speak with Ragnar Thunderbrew.

quests.name: The Knife Revealed
objectiveText: Take the Discarded Knife to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Psychometric Reading
objectiveText: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Woodpaw Gnolls
objectiveText: Search the Woodpaw Gnoll camps of southern Feralas for evidence of the courier's belongings or the courier himself.

quests.name: Operation: Death to Angerforge
objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.

quests.name: Vivian Lagrave
objectiveText: Speak with Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

quests.name: Lost Thunderbrew Recipe
objectiveText: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

quests.name: The Writhing Deep
objectiveText: Now that Raschal's last known whereabouts have been discovered, continue your search for him or his remains in the Writhing Deep. According to the note, it is located to the south of the Woodpaw gnoll camps.

quests.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
objectiveText: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Muigin and Larion
objectiveText: Collect 15 Bloodpetals and return to Muigin.

quests.name: A Visit to Gregan
objectiveText: Take a Bloodpetal to Gregan Brewspewer in Feralas.

quests.name: Haze of Evil
objectiveText: Collect 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze, then return to Muigin in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Larion and Muigin
objectiveText: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Zapper Fuel
objectiveText: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Marvon's Workshop
objectiveText: Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

quests.name: Recipe of the Kaldorei
objectiveText: Collect 7 Small Spider Legs for Zarrin in Dolanaar.

quests.name: Goblin Engineering
objectiveText: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Dragonkin Menace
objectiveText: Slay 15 Black Broodlings, 10 Black Dragonspawn, 4 Black Wyrmkin and 1 Black Drake. Return to Helendis Riverhorn when the task is complete.

quests.name: The True Masters
objectiveText: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.

quests.name: The True Masters
objectiveText: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.
Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: The True Masters
objectiveText: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.

quests.name: The True Masters
objectiveText: Take Bolvar's Decree to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

quests.name: The Love Potion
objectiveText: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.

quests.name: The True Masters
objectiveText: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: The True Masters
objectiveText: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task.
You recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.

quests.name: Marshal Windsor
objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Mountain in the northwest and enter Blackrock Depths. Find out what became of Marshal Windsor.
You recall Ragged John talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison.

quests.name: Abandoned Hope
objectiveText: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.

quests.name: Chasing A-Me 01
objectiveText: Find A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Chasing A-Me 01
objectiveText: Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Chasing A-Me 01
objectiveText: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Ancient Spirit
objectiveText: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.

quests.name: Overmaster Pyron
objectiveText: Slay Overmaster Pyron and return to Jalinda Sprig.
You recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?

quests.name: Incendius!
objectiveText: Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!

quests.name: A Crumpled Up Note
objectiveText: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.

quests.name: Freed from the Hive
objectiveText: Free Raschal from the Zukk'ash hive.
Return to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold and let him know that Raschal is alive and well.

quests.name: A Hero's Welcome
objectiveText: Speak with Shandris Feathermoon in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Rise of the Silithid
objectiveText: Bring Raschal's Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

quests.name: Thalanaar Delivery
objectiveText: Bring the Undelivered Parcel to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.

quests.name: A Shred of Hope
objectiveText: Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information.
Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.

quests.name: FIFTY! YEP!
objectiveText: Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Crystals of Power
objectiveText: Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green. Bring them to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: The Northern Pylon
objectiveText: Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Good Stuff
objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.

quests.name: The Eastern Pylon
objectiveText: Discover the location of the Eastern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Western Pylon
objectiveText: Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.

quests.name: The Apes of Un'Goro
objectiveText: Bring 2 Un'Goro Gorilla Pelts, 2 Un'Goro Stomper Pelts, and 2 Un'Goro Thunderer Pelts to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Fare of Lar'korwi
objectiveText: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Scent of Lar'korwi
objectiveText: Bring 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Bait for Lar'korwi
objectiveText: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: A Sample of Slime...
objectiveText: Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

quests.name: ... and a Batch of Ooze
objectiveText: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

quests.name: Tablet of the Seven
objectiveText: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Food for Baby
objectiveText: Bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks to Agnar Beastamer in Hinterlands.

quests.name: Becoming a Parent
objectiveText: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Bone-Bladed Weapons
objectiveText: Bring 8 White Ravasaur Claws to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: The Mighty U'cha
objectiveText: Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Making Sense of It
objectiveText: Speak with J.D. Collie in a moment.

quests.name: Jail Break!
objectiveText: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.

quests.name: Yuka Screwspigot
objectiveText: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Kharan Mighthammer
objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer.
The King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.

quests.name: Kharan's Tale
objectiveText: Listen as Kharan Mighthammer tells his story.

quests.name: The Bearer of Bad News
objectiveText: Return to Ironforge and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.

quests.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
objectiveText: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

quests.name: The Princess's Surprise
objectiveText: Return to Ironforge and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard.

quests.name: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise
objectiveText: Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.

quests.name: The Corruption of the Jadefire
objectiveText: Kill 11 Jadefire Felsworns, 9 Jadefire Shadowstalkers, 9 Jadefire Rogues, and Xavathras. Return to Eridan Bluewind in Felwood when the task has been completed.

quests.name: Felbound Ancients
objectiveText: Travel to Darnassus and use Eridan's Vial to collect a Vial of Blessed Water from the Temple of the Moon. Return to Eridan with the filled vial.

quests.name: Purified!
objectiveText: Speak to Eridan again in a moment.

quests.name: Caught!
objectiveText: Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in Searing Gorge.

quests.name: Ledger from Tanaris
objectiveText: Take the copy of Goodsteel's Ledger and then find the items listed in it before seeking Krinkle Goodsteel in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Key to Freedom
objectiveText: Search Searing Gorge and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.

quests.name: The Tome of Nobility

objectiveText: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.

quests.name: Lorax's Tale
objectiveText: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

quests.name: The Demon Forge
objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.

quests.name: Words of the High Chief
objectiveText: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

quests.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
objectiveText: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Peter Galen in Azshara.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Little Pamela
objectiveText: Find Pamela Redpath.

quests.name: Tribal Leatherworking
objectiveText: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Caryssia Moonhunter in Feralas.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Elemental Leatherworking
objectiveText: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Sarah Tanner in Searing Gorge.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
objectiveText: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Thorkaf Dragoneye in the Badlands.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Elemental Leatherworking
objectiveText: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Brumn Winterhoof in the Arathi Mountains.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Wanted - Arnak Grimtotem
objectiveText: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

quests.name: Tribal Leatherworking
objectiveText: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Se'Jib in Stranglethorn Vale.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Pamela's Doll
objectiveText: Find Pamela's doll.

quests.name: Hypercapacitor Gizmo
objectiveText: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.

quests.name: Auntie Marlene
objectiveText: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.

quests.name: A Strange Historian
objectiveText: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

quests.name: The Annals of Darrowshire
objectiveText: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

quests.name: Forces of Jaedenar
objectiveText: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Verifying the Corruption
objectiveText: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.

quests.name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
objectiveText: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
objectiveText: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

quests.name: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood
objectiveText: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: The Matron Protectorate
objectiveText: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.

quests.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
objectiveText: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.

quests.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
objectiveText: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.

quests.name: Are We There, Yeti?
objectiveText: Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:
Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring)
Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris)
Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater)
When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.

quests.name: Catalogue of the Wayward
objectiveText: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.

quests.name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
objectiveText: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

quests.name: Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight
objectiveText: To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings.

quests.name: Legplates of the Chromatic Defier
objectiveText: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
5 Skin of Shadow.

quests.name: Heroes of Darrowshire
objectiveText: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.

quests.name: Villains of Darrowshire
objectiveText: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: Winterfall Intrusion
objectiveText: Rivern Frostwind wants you to slay 5 Winterfall Shaman and 5 Winterfall Ursa.

quests.name: A Strange Red Key
objectiveText: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

quests.name: Rescue From Jaedenar
objectiveText: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.

quests.name: Retribution of the Light
objectiveText: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

quests.name: Marauders of Darrowshire
objectiveText: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Brother Carlin
objectiveText: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Defenders of Darrowshire
objectiveText: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

quests.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
objectiveText: Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

quests.name: The Active Agent
objectiveText: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: The Great Ezra Grimm
objectiveText: Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

quests.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
objectiveText: Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Felstone Field
objectiveText: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
objectiveText: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
objectiveText: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
objectiveText: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
objectiveText: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
objectiveText: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
objectiveText: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
objectiveText: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
objectiveText: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Felstone Field
objectiveText: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectiveText: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
objectiveText: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectiveText: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
objectiveText: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectiveText: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
objectiveText: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectiveText: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Uncle Carlin
objectiveText: Find Carlin Redpath.

quests.name: A Final Blow
objectiveText: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Houses of the Holy
objectiveText: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.

quests.name: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
objectiveText: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.

quests.name: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril
objectiveText: Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Fragments of the Past
objectiveText: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Fragments of the Past
objectiveText: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Tormented By the Past
objectiveText: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.

quests.name: To Winterspring!
objectiveText: Find Starfall Village in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

quests.name: Starfall
objectiveText: Find Starfall in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

quests.name: The Archivist
objectiveText: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

quests.name: Remorseful Highborne
objectiveText: Speak with Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village, and ask about the proper place for the Crystal of Zin-Malor.

quests.name: The Crystal of Zin-Malor
objectiveText: Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

quests.name: Eagan Peltskinner
objectiveText: Speak with Eagan Peltskinner.

quests.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
objectiveText: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Above and Beyond
objectiveText: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.

quests.name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
objectiveText: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.

quests.name: The Argent Hold
objectiveText: Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.

quests.name: The Restless Souls
objectiveText: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

quests.name: The Restless Souls
objectiveText: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!
Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

quests.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
objectiveText: To become an Armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Grumnus: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

quests.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
objectiveText: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Ironus: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

quests.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
objectiveText: To become an armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Okothos: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

quests.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
objectiveText: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Borgosh: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

quests.name: Sweet Serenity
objectiveText: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.

quests.name: Snakestone of the Shadow Huntress
objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.

quests.name: Corruption
objectiveText: Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.

quests.name: The Sleeper Has Awakened
objectiveText: Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
objectiveText: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

quests.name: The Last Barov
objectiveText: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov.
Be warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
objectiveText: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.

quests.name: The Last Barov
objectiveText: Travel to the Bulwark - Horde territory - and assassinate Alexi Barov. Take his head and return to Weldon Barov.
Be warned, Alexi will probably be well protected by Horde filth.

quests.name: Family Tree
objectiveText: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

quests.name: Hand of Iruxos
objectiveText: Retrieve the Demon Box from Thunder Axe Fortress, and return it, along with the Demon Pick to Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village.

quests.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
objectiveText: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

quests.name: Kirtonos the Herald
objectiveText: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.

quests.name: The Remains of Trey Lightforge
objectiveText: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.

quests.name: Catch of the Day
objectiveText: Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.

quests.name: Lazy Peons
objectiveText: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the Foreman's Blackjack to Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.

quests.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
objectiveText: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

quests.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
objectiveText: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.

quests.name: Menethil's Gift
objectiveText: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.

quests.name: Menethil's Gift
objectiveText: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Soulbound Keepsake
objectiveText: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

quests.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
objectiveText: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.

quests.name: Gordo's Task
objectiveText: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.

quests.name: Doom Weed
objectiveText: Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

quests.name: Bone Collector
objectiveText: Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.

quests.name: A Warden of the Horde
objectiveText: Return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by handing in the Orcish Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Battlewail in the Valley of Honor.

quests.name: Mantles of the Dawn
objectiveText: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Mantles of the Dawn
objectiveText: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Mantles of the Dawn
objectiveText: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Mold Rhymes With...
objectiveText: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
objectiveText: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.

quests.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
objectiveText: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
objectiveText: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.

quests.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
objectiveText: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Leonid Barthalomew
objectiveText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
objectiveText: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Shards of the Felvine
objectiveText: Find the Felvine in Dire Maul and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: A Reliquary of Purity
objectiveText: Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village. If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: Plagued Hatchlings
objectiveText: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: Betina Bigglezink
objectiveText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: Scholomance
objectiveText: Speak with Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Kim'jael's "Missing" Equipment
objectiveText: Find Some Rune that the naga have in their possession in the Ruins of Eldarath and return it to Kim'jael in Azshara.

quests.name: Spiritual Unrest
objectiveText: Destroy 6 Highborne Apparitions and 6 Highborne Lichlings before returning to Loh'atu in Azshara.

quests.name: A Land Filled with Hatred
objectiveText: Kill 6 Haldarr Satyr, 2 Haldarr Tricksters, 2 Haldarr Felsworn and then return to Loh'atu on the border of Ashenvale.

quests.name: Skeletal Fragments
objectiveText: Bring 15 Skeletal Fragments to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Mold Rhymes With...
objectiveText: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Ammo for Rumbleshot
objectiveText: Bring Rumbleshot's Ammo to Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh.

quests.name: Demon Dogs
objectiveText: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.

quests.name: Blood Tinged Skies
objectiveText: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

quests.name: Carrion Grubbage
objectiveText: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.

quests.name: A Bundle of Trouble
objectiveText: Bring 8 Bundles of Wood to Raelen at the Eastvale Logging Camp.

quests.name: Kodo Roundup
objectiveText: Bring five Tamed Kodos and the Kodo Kombobulator back to Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp.

quests.name: Portals of the Legion
objectiveText: Banish 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven and return to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.

quests.name: Healthy Dragon Scale
objectiveText: Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Sister Pamela
objectiveText: Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.

quests.name: Garments of the Moon
objectiveText: Find Sentinel Shaya and heal her wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Laurna Morninglight in Dolanaar.

quests.name: In Favor of Elune
objectiveText: Speak to Laurna Morninglight in Teldrassil.

quests.name: In Favor of the Light
objectiveText: Speak to Priestess Josetta in Elwynn Forest.

quests.name: Garments of the Light
objectiveText: Find Guard Roberts and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Priestess Josetta in Goldshire.

quests.name: Garments of the Light
objectiveText: Find Mountaineer Dolf and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos.

quests.name: In Favor of the Light
objectiveText: Speak to Maxan Anvol in Dun Morogh.

objectiveText: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.

objectiveText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

objectiveText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

objectiveText: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

quests.name: Thazz'ril's Pick

objectiveText: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.

quests.name: The Great Masquerade
objectiveText: Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!

quests.name: Boulderslide Ravine
objectiveText: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.

quests.name: Satyr Horns

quests.name: Naga at the Zoram Strand

quests.name: Troll Charm
objectiveText: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at the Zoram'gar Outpost.

quests.name: Earthen Arise
objectiveText: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.

quests.name: Freedom to Ruul
objectiveText: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Splintertree Post.

quests.name: The Dragon's Eye
objectiveText: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.

quests.name: Drakefire Amulet
objectiveText: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.

quests.name: Ashenvale Outrunners
objectiveText: Kill 9 Ashenvale Outrunners, then return to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost.

quests.name: The Lost Pages
objectiveText: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.

quests.name: An Unholy Alliance
objectiveText: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

quests.name: An Unholy Alliance
objectiveText: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

quests.name: Protect Kaya
objectiveText: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

quests.name: Report to Kadrak
objectiveText: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

quests.name: Report to Kadrak
objectiveText: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

quests.name: The Warsong Reports
objectiveText: Open the Bundle of Reports. Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.

quests.name: Torek's Assault
objectiveText: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.

quests.name: Avenge My Village
objectiveText: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

quests.name: Blackfathom Villainy
objectiveText: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Trouble in the Deeps
objectiveText: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

quests.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
objectiveText: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

quests.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods

quests.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
objectiveText: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

quests.name: What the Wind Carries
objectiveText: Listen to Thrall.

quests.name: The Champion of the Horde
objectiveText: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.

quests.name: The Testament of Rexxar
objectiveText: Deliver Rexxar's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Oculus Illusions
objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.

quests.name: Emberstrife
objectiveText: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.

quests.name: Warsong Supplies
objectiveText: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
objectiveText: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.
You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Somnus
objectiveText: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis
objectiveText: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz
objectiveText: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.

quests.name: Ascension...
objectiveText: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.

quests.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.

quests.name: Trouble in Winterspring!
objectiveText: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.

quests.name: Enraged Wildkin
objectiveText: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper at Starfall Village.

quests.name: A Strange One
objectiveText: Speak with Winna Hazzard in Felwood.

quests.name: A Little Luck
objectiveText: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.

quests.name: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
objectiveText: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish:
Misty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows.
A Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace.
Feralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of Feralas.
Savage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
Return to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!

quests.name: You Too Good.
objectiveText: You think Lumak is trying to tell you that he can no longer help you improve your fishing skill. You may want to try to find his friend, Nat Pagle, a human fishing off one of the islands south of Theramore (at least that's what you think Lumak said).

quests.name: I Got Nothin' Left!
objectiveText: Travel to Kalimdor, to the coastal city of Theramore. From there you must search for an island, south of the main town. Nat Pagle awaits your arrival!

quests.name: Clamlette Surprise
objectiveText: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:
12 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering Tanaris or any other species of large bird.
10 pieces of Zesty Clam Meat. You can find those in clams, naturally!
20 pieces of Alterac Swiss. Get thee to a cheesery!
Gather all of the items and return to Dirge.

quests.name: To Gadgetzan You Go!
objectiveText: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

quests.name: I Know A Guy...
objectiveText: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

quests.name: King of the Foulweald
objectiveText: Place Karang's Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound. Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner. Defeat Chief Murgut and bring Murgut's Totem to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.

quests.name: Triage
objectiveText: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

quests.name: Horde Trauma
objectiveText: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Doctor Gregory Victor about joining the ranks of Horde Trauma.

quests.name: Test of Lore
objectiveText: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.

quests.name: Test of Lore
objectiveText: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in the Undercity until you are ready.

quests.name: Kill Grundig Darkcloud
objectiveText: Kill Grundig Darkcloud and 6 Grimtotem Brutes, and return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

quests.name: Vorsha the Lasher
objectiveText: Keep Muglash safe as he travels to the brazier. Help him by putting the brazier out, then protect him as you fight against the Naga.
If you are successful, return to the Zoram'gar Outpost and inform the Warsong Runner of the death of Vorsha the Lasher.

quests.name: The Manor, Ravenholdt

Your cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.

objectiveText: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

objectiveText: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.

quests.name: Twisted Evils
objectiveText: Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

quests.name: Vyletongue Corruption

Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Talendria in Nijel's Point.

quests.name: You're a Mean One...
objectiveText: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Legends of Maraudon
objectiveText: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.
Find a way to speak with Celebras.

quests.name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
objectiveText: Speak with Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.

quests.name: The Scepter of Celebras
objectiveText: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.
Speak with him when the ritual is complete.

quests.name: The Feast of Winter Veil
objectiveText: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: The Reason for the Season
objectiveText: Speak with Historian Karnik at the Explorer's League in Ironforge about the Feast of Winter Veil.

quests.name: The Feast of Winter Veil
objectiveText: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

quests.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
objectiveText: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

quests.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
objectiveText: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

quests.name: Seed of Life
objectiveText: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.

quests.name: The Pariah's Instructions
objectiveText: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

quests.name: Shadowshard Fragments
objectiveText: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Shadowshard Fragments
objectiveText: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.

quests.name: Alterac Valley Graveyards
objectiveText: Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: The Graveyards of Alterac
objectiveText: Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Towers and Bunkers
objectiveText: Capture an enemy tower, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Towers and Bunkers
objectiveText: Destroy the banner at an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: The Quartermaster
objectiveText: Speak with the Stormpike Quartermaster.

quests.name: Capture a Mine
objectiveText: Capture a mine that the Stormpike does not control, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Speak with our Quartermaster
objectiveText: Speak with the Frostwolf Quartermaster.

quests.name: Capture a Mine

quests.name: The Battle of Alterac
objectiveText: Enter Alterac Valley, defeat the Horde general Drek'thar, and then return to Prospector Stonehewer in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: The Battle for Alterac
objectiveText: Enter Alterac Valley and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike. Then, return to Voggah Deathgrip in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Proving Grounds
objectiveText: Travel to the Wildpaw cavern located southeast of the main base in Alterac Valley and find the Frostwolf Banner. Return the Frostwolf Banner to Warmaster Laggrond.

quests.name: Proving Grounds
objectiveText: Travel to the Icewing Caverns located southwest of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley and recover the Stormpike Banner. Return the Stormpike Banner to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: The Legend of Korrak
objectiveText: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Warmaster Laggrond.

quests.name: The Last Element
objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.

quests.name: Korrak the Bloodrager
objectiveText: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Speak with Prospector Stonehewer
objectiveText: Speak with Prospector Stonehewer in the Dun Baldar garrison.

quests.name: Speak with Voggah Deathgrip
objectiveText: Speak with Voggah in Frostwolf Keep.

quests.name: Armor Scraps
objectiveText: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.

quests.name: Enemy Booty
objectiveText: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.

quests.name: In Defense of Frostwolf
objectiveText: Venture to Alterac Valley, located in the Alterac Mountains. Find and speak with Warmaster Laggrond - who stands outside the tunnel entrance - to begin your career as a soldier of Frostwolf. You will find Alterac Valley north of Tarren Mill at the base of the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: The Sovereign Imperative
objectiveText: Travel to Alterac Valley in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Outside of the entrance tunnel, find and speak with Lieutenant Haggerdin.
For the glory of Bronzebeard!

quests.name: Brotherly Love
objectiveText: Travel into Stormpike territory and slay Commander Karl Philips. Return to Commander Louis Philips when the task is complete.

quests.name: Brotherly Love
objectiveText: Travel into Frostwolf territory and slay Commander Louis Philips. Return to Commander Karl Philips when the task is complete.
