objectiveText: Travel to Frostwolf territory and search for Wing Commander Slidore, Wing Commander Vipore, and Wing Commander Ichman. Return to Commander Duffy should you complete your mission.

quests.name: Fallen Sky Lords
objectiveText: Find out what became of Wing Commander Guse, Wing Commander Jeztor, and Wing Commander Mulverick. Return to Commander Mulfort should you complete your mission.

quests.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
objectiveText: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Favor Amongst the Darkspear
objectiveText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing night elf players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a night elf and return to Najak Hexxen at Frostwolf Keep with a Severed Night Elf Head.

quests.name: Ally of the Tauren
objectiveText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing gnome players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a gnome and return to Ravak Grimtotem at Frostwolf Keep with a Tuft of Gnome Hair.

quests.name: The Human Condition
objectiveText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing human players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a human and return to Commander Louis Philips (who wanders between the front lines and Frostwolf keep) with a Human Bone Chip.
A cure for the human condition is close at hand!

quests.name: Gnomeregan Bounty
objectiveText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing tauren players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a tauren and return to Dirk Swindle at Dun'Baldar with a Tauren Hoof.

quests.name: Staghelm's Requiem
objectiveText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing troll players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a troll and return to Athramanis at Dun'Baldar with Darkspear Troll Mojo.

quests.name: The Archbishop's Mercy
objectiveText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Forsaken players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a Forsaken and return to Commander Karl Philips (who wanders between the lumber mill and the mine) with a Forsaken Heart.

quests.name: Defusing the Threat
objectiveText: Find the Frostwolf Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Stormpike Explosives Expert when the task is complete.

quests.name: Defusing the Threat
objectiveText: Find the Stormpike Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Frostwolf Explosives Expert when the task is complete.

quests.name: The Return of Korrak
objectiveText: Should Korrak the Bloodrager make a return to the Field of Strife, seek him out and destroy him.
Return the Skull of Korrak to Warmaster Laggrond in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

quests.name: Korrak the Everliving
objectiveText: Should Korrak the Bloodrager make a return to the Field of Strife, seek him out and destroy him.
Return the Skull of Korrak to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

quests.name: Crown of the Earth
objectiveText: Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.

quests.name: Wanted: DWARVES!
objectiveText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Dwarf players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a Dwarf and rip out their spine. Take the Dwarf Spine to Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl at Frostwolf Keep.

quests.name: Wanted: ORCS!
objectiveText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Orc players in Alterac Valley.
Kill an Orc and take their Orc Tooth back to Corporal Noreg Stormpike at Dun Baldar.

quests.name: I've Got A Fever For More Bone Chips
Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin
objectiveText: Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.

quests.name: The Madness Within
objectiveText: You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated.
Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum.
Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.

quests.name: The Treasure of the Shen'dralar
objectiveText: Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!

quests.name: Arcane Refreshment
objectiveText: Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.

quests.name: Elven Legends
objectiveText: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.

quests.name: Elven Legends
objectiveText: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.

quests.name: Libram of Rapidity
objectiveText: Bring a Libram of Rapidity, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Blood of Heroes to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Rapidity.

quests.name: Libram of Focus
objectiveText: Bring a Libram of Focus, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 4 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Skin of Shadow to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Focus.

quests.name: Libram of Protection
objectiveText: Bring a Libram of Protection, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 1 Frayed Abomination Stitching to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Protection.

quests.name: A Hero's Reward
objectiveText: Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.

quests.name: Lethtendris's Web
objectiveText: Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

quests.name: Lethtendris's Web
objectiveText: Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

quests.name: Victory for the Horde
objectiveText: Take the Head of Onyxia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: For All To See
objectiveText: Seek out Overlord Runthak in the Valley of Strength.

quests.name: Camp Mojache
objectiveText: Speak with Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

quests.name: Feathermoon Stronghold
objectiveText: Speak with Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

quests.name: Victory for the Alliance
objectiveText: Take the Head of Onyxia to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.

quests.name: Celebrating Good Times
objectiveText: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.

quests.name: Garona: A Study on Stealth and Treachery
objectiveText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

quests.name: Codex of Defense
objectiveText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

quests.name: The Arcanist's Cookbook
objectiveText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

quests.name: The Light and How To Swing It
objectiveText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

quests.name: Harnessing Shadows
objectiveText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

quests.name: The Greatest Race of Hunters
objectiveText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

quests.name: Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You
objectiveText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

quests.name: Frost Shock and You
objectiveText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

quests.name: The Emerald Dream...
objectiveText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

quests.name: Nostro's Compendium
objectiveText: Return Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying to the Athenaeum.

quests.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
objectiveText: Give the Dull and Flat Elven Blade to Lorekeeper Lydros.

quests.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
objectiveText: You must get Onyxia to breathe fire on the Unfired Ancient Blade. Once this is done, pick up the now Heated Ancient Blade. Be warned, a Heated Ancient Blade will not remain heated forever - time is of the essence.
The last step before returning to me is to slay the beast and drive the Heated Ancient Blade into her corpse.
Do this and Quel'Serrar will be yours.

quests.name: Mor'zul Bloodbringer
objectiveText: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Rage of Blood
objectiveText: Bring 30 bottles of Raging Beast's Blood to Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Wildeyes
objectiveText: Bring the Case of Blood to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: The Prison's Bindings
objectiveText: Travel to Dire Maul in Feralas and recover 15 Satyr Blood from the Wildspawn Satyr that inhabit the Warpwood Quarter. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when this is done.

quests.name: The Prison's Casing
objectiveText: Travel to Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring and recover 5 Tears of the Hederine from the Hederine demons that occupy the gorge. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when you have completed this task.

quests.name: Suppression
objectiveText: Venture forth into the Tainted Scar and locate a Doomguard Commander.
Use the Glowing Crystal Prison on the Doomguard Commander. Be prepared for a ferocious onslaught of attacks, as the demon attempts to escape capture.
Should you succeed, return the Imprisoned Doomguard to Daio in the Tainted Scar.

quests.name: What Niby Commands
objectiveText: Speak with Impsy in Felwood.

quests.name: Flawless Fel Essence
objectiveText: Impsy in Felwood has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations.

The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Felguard Sentries of the Blasted Lands hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region.
Recover the Flawless Fel Essences and return to Impsy in Felwood.

quests.name: Kroshius' Infernal Core
objectiveText: Search Shatter Scar Vale in Felwood for the remains of Kroshius. When you locate the remains, use the Fel Fire near them and await Kroshius' return. When the infernal has awoken, slay him and take from his corpse Kroshius' Infernal Core.
Return Kroshius' Infernal Core to Niby the Almighty in Felwood.

quests.name: A Binding Contract
objectiveText: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.

quests.name: The Balance of Light and Shadow
objectiveText: Save 50 Peasants before 15 are slain. Speak with Eris Havenfire should you accomplish this task.
You may view the Death Post to view how many Peasants have been slain.

quests.name: Lord Banehollow
objectiveText: Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
Use the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.

quests.name: Ulathek the Traitor
objectiveText: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.

quests.name: Xorothian Stardust
objectiveText: Purchase Xorothian Stardust from Ur'dan. Bring it to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Bell of Dethmoora
objectiveText: Bring 10 Elixirs of Shadow Power to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Wheel of the Black March
objectiveText: Bring 6 Large Brilliant Shards and 25 Dark Iron Ore to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Doomsday Candle
objectiveText: Bring 35 Black Dragonscales to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Imp Delivery
objectiveText: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance. After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.

quests.name: Arcanite
objectiveText: Bring 3 Arcanite Bar to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Dreadsteed of Xoroth
objectiveText: Read Mor'zul's Instructions. Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.

quests.name: The Ancient Leaf
objectiveText: Find the owner of the Ancient Petrified Leaf. Good luck, <Name>; It's a big world.

quests.name: Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina
objectiveText: Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in Felwood.

quests.name: A Proper String
objectiveText: Stoma the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Black Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Stoma in Felwood.

quests.name: Stave of the Ancients
objectiveText: You must find and destroy these four demonic corrupters:
Simone the Seductress.
Klinfran the Crazed.
Solenor the Slayer.
Artorius the Doombringer.
Destroy these creatures and return to Vartrus the Ancient in Felwood with their heads.
Refer to the Petrified Bark in your inventory for clues as to their whereabouts.
You MUST complete this task by yourself.

quests.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
objectiveText: Travel to Ironforge and get High Priest Rohan's Exorcism Censer. You will need to make a donation of 150 gold in order to secure it.

quests.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
objectiveText: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

quests.name: To Show Due Judgment
objectiveText: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Exorcising Terrordale
objectiveText: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale. When you have slain 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
objectiveText: Speak with Grimand Elmore in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

quests.name: Collection of Goods
objectiveText: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Ancient Equine Spirit

zones.zone: Dire Maul Court Of The Highborne

objectiveText: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Merideth Carlson in Southshore apparently is the source for such food.

Travel to the Dire Maul dungeon in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed, thereby soothing the spirit. Finally, give it the Arcanite Barding so it may bless it.

quests.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
quests.zone: Dire Maul Court Of The Highborne

zones.zone: Dire Maul Court Of The Highborne

objectiveText: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
objectiveText: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits.
You also need to give her 50 gold to soothe her ruffled sensibilities.

quests.name: The Divination Scryer
objectiveText: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Judgment and Redemption
objectiveText: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver. Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.
Give the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.

quests.name: Grimand's Finest Work
objectiveText: Take the Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District for his inspection.

quests.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume I
objectiveText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

quests.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume II
objectiveText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

quests.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume III
objectiveText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

quests.name: Material Assistance
objectiveText: If you are interested in helping Sagorne Crestrider in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.

quests.name: The Darkreaver Menace
objectiveText: Bring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
objectiveText: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

quests.name: White Stallion Exchange
objectiveText: If you bring me your white stallion, I'll trade you for one from the new herd. The new horse will be just as fast as your old one, but have a different look to it. You can look at the swift steeds here to see what it will look like.
MUST PAY 500 Gold too....

quests.name: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius
objectiveText: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius.
Slay Overseer Maltorius and take his head. Return the head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker in the Searing Gorge for your reward.

quests.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
objectiveText: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.

quests.name: Look at the Size of It!
objectiveText: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.

quests.name: Fuel for the Zapping
objectiveText: Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

quests.name: What the Flux?
objectiveText: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.

quests.name: Curse These Fat Fingers
objectiveText: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.
The Heavy War Golems wander the areas surrounding the Cauldron in the Searing Gorge. When you've killed enough, return to Hansel in Searing Gorge.

quests.name: Fiery Menace!
objectiveText: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Greater Lava Spiders.

quests.name: Again With the Zapped Giants
objectiveText: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 10 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

quests.name: Refuel for the Zapping
objectiveText: Collect 6 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

quests.name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
objectiveText: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.
You will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.

quests.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
objectiveText: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.

The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.

quests.name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
objectiveText: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.

quests.name: Zukk'ash Infestation
objectiveText: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Stinglasher
objectiveText: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Zukk'ash Report
objectiveText: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore. He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Improved Quality
objectiveText: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

quests.name: Improved Quality
objectiveText: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Pristine Yeti Hide
objectiveText: Bring the Pristine Yeti Hide to Pratt McGrubben at the Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

quests.name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Kingsblood
Perfect Yeti Hide
objectiveText: Bring the Perfect Yeti Hide to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Blackhand's Command
objectiveText: That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.
The letter indicates that General Drakkisath guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.

quests.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectiveText: Return the Head of Nefarian to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.

quests.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectiveText: Venture to the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.

quests.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectiveText: Return the Head of Nefarian to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectiveText: Speak with High Overlord Saurfang in Orgrimmar. He stands waiting for you in the Valley of Strength.

quests.name: Examine the Vessel
objectiveText: Examine the Vessel of Rebirth and return it to Highlord Demitrian.

quests.name: Thunderaan the Windseeker
objectiveText: To free Thunderaan the Windseeker from his prison, you must present the right and left halves of the Bindings of the Windseeker, 10 bars of Elementium, and the Essence of the Firelord to Highlord Demitrian in Silithus.

quests.name: Rise, Thunderfury!
objectiveText: Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian.

quests.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
objectiveText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.

quests.name: Quell the Silverwing Usurpers
objectiveText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.

quests.name: Arena Master
objectiveText: Speak with Short John Mithril in the Stranglethorn Arena.

quests.name: Snapjaws, Mon!
objectiveText: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.

quests.name: Gammerita, Mon!
objectiveText: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.
Katoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.

quests.name: Stalking the Stalkers
objectiveText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Silvermane Stalkers and 10 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Hunt the Savages
objectiveText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Avenging the Fallen
objectiveText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Vilebranch Hooligans
objectiveText: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.
You recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.

quests.name: Lard Lost His Lunch
objectiveText: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.
Lard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.

quests.name: Message to the Wildhammer
objectiveText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers. Return to him when this task is complete.
You can find the Highvale high elves at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the northwestern region of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
objectiveText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.
Gryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
objectiveText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete.
Beware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the Alliance.

quests.name: Cannibalistic Cousins
objectiveText: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.
Yayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
objectiveText: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.
You have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern region of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Recover the Key!
objectiveText: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.

quests.name: Return to Primal Torntusk
objectiveText: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.

quests.name: Attunement to the Core
objectiveText: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.

quests.name: Separation Anxiety
objectiveText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.

Markhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both of these places are near the top of the temple.

quests.name: Dark Vessels
objectiveText: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 10 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.

quests.name: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
objectiveText: You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 20 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete.
Vile Priestess Hexx and the Aman'zasi Guards can be found atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village
objectiveText: You have been tasked with the decimation of 20 Vilebranch Berserkers, 20 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 20 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 20 Vilebranch Soul Eaters.
Should you complete this task, return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
objectiveText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.

quests.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
objectiveText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.

quests.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
objectiveText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.

quests.name: Quell the Silverwing Usurpers

quests.name: Field Duty
objectiveText: Report to Krug Skullsplit at the Orgrimmar Legion post in front of Hive'Regal. Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers, obtain Signed Field Duty Papers and bring them to Windcaller Kaldon in Cenarion Hold.
Note: Healing or casting beneficial spells on a member of the Orgrimmar Legion will flag you for PvP.

quests.name: Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream

quests.name: Tyrande and Remulos

quests.name: The Nightmare's Corruption
objectiveText: Travel to the four Emerald Dream portals in Azeroth and collect a Fragment of the Nightmare's Corruption from each. Return to Keeper Remulos in the Moonglade when you have completed this task.

quests.name: The Nightmare Manifests
objectiveText: Defend Nighthaven from Eranikus. Do not let Keeper Remulos perish. Do not slay Eranikus. Defend yourself. Await Tyrande.

quests.name: Azure Templar
objectiveText: Summon and slay an Azure Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Hive'Ashi Scout Report

quests.name: Twilight Marauders

quests.name: Metzen the Reindeer

objectiveSteps.text: Find Metzen the Reindeer and rescue him

objectiveText: Find Metzen the Reindeer. Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.
When you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.
Return the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar once Metzen is freed.
